messages:
Jess C: FYI we have a customer (AcmeCorp / acct_4821) reporting invoice > dashboard for Feb. Invoice shows $4,520 total, dashboard shows $3,240. Customer is upset, wants explanation. attaching invoice link: https://invoices.redwood/acct_4821/2026-02
Sarah B (Billing): Can you paste the invoice id and the billing period? Also want the dashboard snapshot timestamp.
Jess C: Invoice ID INV-2026-4821-02. Period 2026-02-01 -> 2026-02-28. Dashboard screenshot taken 2026-03-01T01:05:12-07:00 (PST). Customer claims tokens billed on invoice include a 320k-token chunk not visible on dashboard.
Kevin - Billing Eng: tagging @Ajay P and @Maria (Support). First guesses: (1) late backfill inserted into ledger after dashboard snapshot, (2) timezone/cutoff mismatch between metering and invoice job, or (3) duplicate aggregation.
Ajay P: Backfill job ran 2026-03-01T00:12:40Z (job id backfill-2026-03-01-00). Logs show a batch processed for acct_4821 with a nonzero insert count. snippet: ```[2026-03-01T00:12:40Z] backfill-2026-03-01-00 acct=4821 inserted=318450 tokens source=embed-job-queue```
Maria (Support): Customer says they were using old plan (Starter) most of month then upgraded to Pro on 2026-02-28 23:50 PST. Could plan change have reclassified prior usage?
Kevin - Billing Eng: Good catch. Our billing-aggregator has a cutoff that applies plan mapping at invoice-time. Dashboard uses live plan at event-time for attribution. If upgrade happened before cutoff in one system and after in the other, tokens can flip tiers.
Sarah B (Billing): Requesting SQL counts to reconcile quickly. Would appreciate a reproducible query.
Kevin - Billing Eng: Run this against metering and ledger to compare: 
```sql
-- meter sum by recorded_plan
SELECT recorded_plan, SUM(tokens) as tokens 
FROM metering.events 
WHERE account_id = 4821 AND ts >= '2026-02-01' AND ts < '2026-03-01' 
GROUP BY recorded_plan;

-- ledger posted tokens (invoice perspective)
SELECT billing_plan, SUM(tokens) as tokens 
FROM billing.aggregates 
WHERE account_id = 4821 AND period = '2026-02'
GROUP BY billing_plan;
```
Maria (Support): I ran quick checks: metering.events shows 2,900,000 tokens under Starter and 120,000 under Pro. billing.aggregates shows 3,340,450 tokens under Pro (matches invoice big chunk). So ledger has moved a chunk to Pro.
Ajay P: That lines up with backfill log — backfill process re-ingested some embed-job records and assigned them the account's CURRENT plan on re-ingest (bug). Backfill used plan lookup at process-time instead of event-time.
Jess C: Customer wants credit for difference and a root cause. What's the remediation?
Kevin - Billing Eng: Short-term: issue a billing credit for the overbilled amount (we should compute delta between ledger and dashboard attribution for Feb). Mid-term: patch backfill to use event_time plan lookup, re-run aggregation for acct_4821 for Feb with corrected attribution, and regenerate invoice if customer prefers.
Sarah B (Billing): Approve credit pending exact delta. Please calculate dollar impact and add to ticket CS-7821.
Maria (Support): I will tell customer we can issue a credit immediately and follow up once re-run completes. Please confirm if we need a full invoice regen or just a credit.
Kevin - Billing Eng: If we re-run aggregation and it changes invoice totals, finance prefers invoice regeneration only for >$500 diffs; otherwise issue credit. I'll compute delta and flag.
Ajay P: Patch submitted to backfill service: change plan resolution to use snapshot at event_time (PR #925). Will deploy canary tonight and run targeted re-agg for acct_4821.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-4821-02 processed at 2026-03-02T03:14:12Z (automated).
Jess C: Thanks all. Maria — please confirm customer ok with credit then we proceed with re-agg if needed. Kevin / Ajay please post results of the compare query and estimated credit amount here. :thumbsup:
Maria (Support): Customer accepted provisional credit via support ticket. I'll add their written approval to CS-7821.
Kevin - Billing Eng: Quick calc: ledger sum = 3,340,450 tokens, dashboard/event attribution = 3,020,000 tokens. Delta = 320,450 tokens. At $0.0008/token => $256.36. Below regen threshold. Recommend issuing credit of $256.36.
Sarah B (Billing): Approved. I'll create the credit memo and link to INV-2026-4821-02.
Jess C: Great. Closing loop with customer now. Please add postmortem once PR #925 deploys and re-agg completes.
Maria (Support): Will do. Posting ticket update and closing Slack loop. :white_check_mark:
